name: CapCut
tagline: Turn your clips into social videos with timeline editing, captions, effects, and templates.
description:
CapCut Desktop is a video editor for Mac and Windows that combines a conventional timeline editor with templates, effects, captions, and a growing set of AI-assisted tools. It is aimed at quick social video production as well as more detailed editing, letting a creator move from raw clips to a short, platform-specific export in one environment.

Use it to cut clips, arrange media, add text and audio, then apply the tools that match the project—automatic captions, smart media search, color adjustment, keyframe animation, or an adjusted aspect ratio. Cloud project access and direct publishing tools can be convenient for a multi-device workflow, but they also mean media and account choices deserve attention.

## Features

- Edit video and audio on a timeline with effects, filters, transitions, text, and a broad import and export format range.
- Generate captions from video or audio, work with transcript-based editing, and use text-to-speech or other current voice tools where available.
- Search local media by objects, dialogue, and people to find clips in a larger project.
- Animate with keyframes and graphs, then apply color-wheel controls and automatic color adjustment.
- Use AI-assisted options such as background removal, stabilization, script-to-video, dubbing, resizing, and short-form conversion when the current account and plan allow them.
- Store and access projects through the service’s current multi-device cloud workflow when that convenience is worth the associated account and privacy tradeoff.

## Where it fits

CapCut fits creators producing short social videos, tutorials, reels, and quick marketing edits who value an approachable editor with many ready-made tools. It can also serve a more involved edit when the timeline and animation controls are sufficient for the project.

It is not the simplest choice for someone who only needs a trim, and its AI and cloud features should not be treated as permanent or universally included. Review current plan limits, licensing, privacy, and export requirements before basing a business workflow on them.

## Privacy and requirements

CapCut Desktop supports macOS 10.14 or later, although individual AI features can have newer hardware or service requirements. Local projects, cloud projects, templates, stock media, account sync, and AI processing do not share one privacy model: content may leave the Mac when a cloud-backed feature is used. Check the current privacy, licensing, and commercial-use terms before uploading confidential or client-owned media.

## Pricing

CapCut includes a free tier. Pro $19.99/month or $179.99/year.
